mapper.sql: SELECT i.ITEM_ID, i.BOARD_ID, i.OWNER_USERNAME, i.GROUP_ID, i.CATEGORY_ID, i.CONTENT AS TITLE, i.CONTENT, i.DESCRIPTION, i.STATUS, i.PRIORITY, i.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME, i.REQUEST_DATE, i.DUE_DATE, i.PREVIOUS_STATUS, i.COMPLETED_BY, i.DELETED_AT, i.DELETED_BY, i.TRANSFERRED_FROM, i.TRANSFERRED_AT, i.SORT_ORDER, i.CREATED_AT, i.CREATED_BY, i.UPDATED_AT, i.UPDATED_BY, /* v2.2: 하위 업무 필드 */ i.PARENT_ITEM_ID, i.ITEM_DEPTH, i.CHILD_SORT_ORDER, /* v2.2: 하위 업무 계산 필드 */ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITEM child WHERE child.PARENT_ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID AND child.STATUS != 'DELETED') AS CHILD_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITEM child WHERE child.PARENT_ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID AND child.STATUS = 'COMPLETED') AS COMPLETED_CHILD_COUNT, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ITEM child WHERE child.PARENT_ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID AND child.STATUS != 'DELETED')) AS HAS_CHILDREN, (COALESCE(i.ITEM_DEPTH, 0) < 2) AS CAN_CREATE_CHILD, /* v2.2: 부모 업무 정보 */ parent.CONTENT AS PARENT_TITLE, parent.STATUS AS PARENT_STATUS, /* v2.2: 최상위 업무 정보 (CTE 없이 2단계 조인) */ COALESCE(grandparent.ITEM_ID, parent.ITEM_ID) AS ROOT_ITEM_ID, COALESCE(grandparent.CONTENT, parent.CONTENT) AS ROOT_TITLE, COALESCE(grandparent.STATUS, parent.STATUS) AS ROOT_STATUS, b.BOARD_NAME, uo.NAME AS OWNER_NAME, g.GROUP_NAME, g.GROUP_COLOR, cat.CATEGORY_NAME, cat.CATEGORY_COLOR, ua.NAME AS ASSIGNEE_NAME, uc.NAME AS CREATED_BY_NAME, uu.NAME AS UPDATED_BY_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMENT c WHERE c.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID) AS COMMENT_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITEM_SHARE s WHERE s.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID AND s.DELETED_AT IS NULL) AS SHARE_COUNT, /* 이관 정보 - 원본 보드의 소유자가 이관자 */ tb_orig.OWNER_USERNAME AS TRANSFERRED_BY_USERNAME, ut.NAME AS TRANSFERRED_BY_USER_NAME, /* 공유 정보 - 기본값 NULL (공유 업무 조회 시 별도 설정) */ NULL AS IS_SHARED_TO_ME, NULL AS SHARED_BY_USERNAME, NULL AS SHARED_BY_USER_NAME, /* v2.1: 배정 정보 (소유자 화면용) - 기본값 NULL (공유 업무 조회 시 별도 설정) */ NULL AS IS_ASSIGNED_TO_ME, ish_assign.ASSIGNED_BY AS ASSIGNED_BY_USERNAME, uab.NAME AS ASSIGNED_BY_USER_NAME, ish_assign.ASSIGNED_AT AS ASSIGNED_AT, /* v2.1: 배정 대상 정보 (소유자 화면용) - 누구에게 배정했는지 */ ish_assign.USERNAME AS ASSIGNED_TO_USERNAME, uat.NAME AS ASSIGNED_TO_USER_NAME FROM TB_ITEM i INNER JOIN TB_BOARD b ON i.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER uo ON i.OWNER_USERNAME = uo.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_GROUP g ON i.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CATEGORY cat ON i.CATEGORY_ID = cat.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER ua ON i.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME = ua.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER uc ON i.CREATED_BY = uc.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER uu ON i.UPDATED_BY = uu.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_BOARD tb_orig ON i.TRANSFERRED_FROM = tb_orig.BOARD_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER ut ON tb_orig.OWNER_USERNAME = ut.USERNAME /* v2.2: 부모/조부모 업무 조인 */ LEFT JOIN TB_ITEM parent ON i.PARENT_ITEM_ID = parent.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_ITEM grandparent ON parent.PARENT_ITEM_ID = grandparent.ITEM_ID /* v2.1: 배정 정보 조인 - SHARE_TYPE='ASSIGN'인 활성 배정만 조회 */ LEFT JOIN TB_ITEM_SHARE ish_assign ON i.ITEM_ID = ish_assign.ITEM_ID AND ish_assign.SHARE_TYPE = 'ASSIGN' LEFT JOIN TB_USER uab ON ish_assign.ASSIGNED_BY = uab.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER uat ON ish_assign.USERNAME = uat.USERNAME
mapper.select: WHERE i.ITEM_ID = #{itemId}

WHERE i.BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND ( (i.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND DATE(i.UPDATED_AT) = CURDATE()) OR (i.STATUS = 'DELETED' AND DATE(i.DELETED_AT) = CURDATE()) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN i.UPDATED_AT ELSE i.DELETED_AT END DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(SORT_ORDER), -1) FROM TB_ITEM WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND STATUS NOT IN ('DELETED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ITEM ( BOARD_ID, OWNER_USERNAME, GROUP_ID, CATEGORY_ID, PARENT_ITEM_ID, ITEM_DEPTH, CHILD_SORT_ORDER, CONTENT, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, PRIORITY, ASSIGNEE_USERNAME, REQUEST_DATE, DUE_DATE, SORT_ORDER, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{ownerUsername}, #{groupId}, #{categoryId}, #{parentItemId}, COALESCE(#{itemDepth}, 0), #{childSortOrder}, COALESCE(#{content}, #{title}), #{description}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'NOT_STARTED'), COALESCE(#{priority}, 'NORMAL'), #{assigneeUsername}, #{requestDate}, #{dueDate}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ITEM SET GROUP_ID = #{groupId}, CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}, CONTENT = COALESCE(#{content}, #{title}), DESCRIPTION = #{description}, STATUS = #{status}, PRIORITY = #{priority}, ASSIGNEE_USERNAME = #{assigneeUsername}, REQUEST_DATE = #{requestDate}, DUE_DATE = #{dueDate}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
UPDATE TB_ITEM SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
UPDATE TB_ITEM SET PREVIOUS_STATUS = STATUS, STATUS = 'COMPLETED', COMPLETED_BY = #{completedBy}, UPDATED_BY = #{completedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}

UPDATE TB_ITEM SET PREVIOUS_STATUS = STATUS, STATUS = 'DELETED', DELETED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, DELETED_BY = #{deletedBy}, UPDATED_BY = #{deletedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}

UPDATE TB_ITEM SET STATUS = COALESCE(PREVIOUS_STATUS, 'NOT_STARTED'), PREVIOUS_STATUS = NULL, DELETED_AT = NULL, DELETED_BY = NULL, COMPLETED_BY = NULL, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
UPDATE TB_ITEM SET SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITEM i INNER JOIN TB_BOARD b ON i.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID WHERE i.DUE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND i.DUE_DATE < CURDATE() AND i.STATUS NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELETED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITEM i INNER JOIN TB_BOARD b ON i.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID WHERE i.STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ITEM SET BOARD_ID = #{newBoardId}, OWNER_USERNAME = #{newOwnerUsername}, TRANSFERRED_FROM = #{originalBoardId}, TRANSFERRED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} OR PARENT_ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
UPDATE TB_ITEM SET OWNER_USERNAME = #{newOwnerUsername}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITEM WHERE OWNER_USERNAME = #{ownerUsername} AND STATUS NOT IN ('DELETED')

mapper.select: SELECT i.ITEM_ID, i.BOARD_ID, i.GROUP_ID, i.CATEGORY_ID, i.CONTENT, i.CONTENT AS TITLE, i.DESCRIPTION, i.STATUS, i.PRIORITY, i.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME, i.REQUEST_DATE, i.DUE_DATE, i.SORT_ORDER, i.PREVIOUS_STATUS, i.COMPLETED_BY, i.DELETED_AT, i.DELETED_BY, i.TRANSFERRED_FROM, i.TRANSFERRED_AT, i.CREATED_AT, i.CREATED_BY, i.UPDATED_AT, i.UPDATED_BY, b.BOARD_NAME, g.GROUP_NAME, g.GROUP_COLOR, c.CATEGORY_NAME, c.CATEGORY_COLOR, ua.NAME AS ASSIGNEE_NAME, uc.NAME AS CREATED_BY_NAME, uu.NAME AS UPDATED_BY_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMENT cm WHERE cm.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID) AS COMMENT_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITEM_SHARE s WHERE s.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID AND s.DELETED_AT IS NULL) AS SHARE_COUNT, /* 이관 정보 */ tb_orig.OWNER_USERNAME AS TRANSFERRED_BY_USERNAME, ut.NAME AS TRANSFERRED_BY_USER_NAME FROM TB_ITEM i INNER JOIN TB_BOARD b ON i.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER uo ON i.OWNER_USERNAME = uo.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_GROUP g ON i.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CATEGORY c ON i.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER ua ON i.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME = ua.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER uc ON i.CREATED_BY = uc.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER uu ON i.UPDATED_BY = uu.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_BOARD tb_orig ON i.TRANSFERRED_FROM = tb_orig.BOARD_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER ut ON tb_orig.OWNER_USERNAME = ut.USERNAME WHERE i.ITEM_ID = #{itemId}

WHERE i.PARENT_ITEM_ID = #{parentItemId}
AND i.STATUS != 'COMPLETED'
AND i.STATUS != 'DELETED'
ORDER BY i.CHILD_SORT_ORDER ASC, i.CREATED_AT ASC

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT ITEM_ID, PARENT_ITEM_ID, ITEM_DEPTH FROM TB_ITEM WHERE PARENT_ITEM_ID = #{parentItemId} UNION ALL SELECT c.ITEM_ID, c.PARENT_ITEM_ID, c.ITEM_DEPTH FROM TB_ITEM c INNER JOIN descendants d ON c.PARENT_ITEM_ID = d.ITEM_ID )
WHERE i.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT ITEM_ID FROM descendants) ORDER BY i.ITEM_DEPTH ASC, i.CHILD_SORT_ORDER ASC

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT ITEM_ID, PARENT_ITEM_ID, CONTENT, STATUS, ITEM_DEPTH, 0 AS LEVEL FROM TB_ITEM WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} UNION ALL SELECT p.ITEM_ID, p.PARENT_ITEM_ID, p.CONTENT, p.STATUS, p.ITEM_DEPTH, a.LEVEL + 1 FROM TB_ITEM p INNER JOIN ancestors a ON p.ITEM_ID = a.PARENT_ITEM_ID ) SELECT a.ITEM_ID, a.ITEM_DEPTH, a.CONTENT AS TITLE, a.CONTENT, a.STATUS FROM ancestors a ORDER BY a.LEVEL DESC

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT ITEM_ID, PARENT_ITEM_ID FROM TB_ITEM WHERE PARENT_ITEM_ID = #{parentItemId} AND STATUS NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELETED') UNION ALL SELECT c.ITEM_ID, c.PARENT_ITEM_ID FROM TB_ITEM c INNER JOIN descendants d ON c.PARENT_ITEM_ID = d.ITEM_ID WHERE c.STATUS NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELETED') )
WHERE i.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT ITEM_ID FROM descendants) AND i.STATUS NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELETED') ORDER BY i.ITEM_DEPTH ASC, i.CHILD_SORT_ORDER ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITEM WHERE PARENT_ITEM_ID = #{parentItemId}
AND STATUS != 'DELETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ITEM SET CHILD_SORT_ORDER = #{childSortOrder}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CHILD_SORT_ORDER), 0) FROM TB_ITEM WHERE PARENT_ITEM_ID = #{parentItemId} AND STATUS != 'DELETED'

WHERE i.BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND (i.PARENT_ITEM_ID IS NULL OR i.ITEM_DEPTH = 0)
AND i.STATUS != 'COMPLETED'
AND i.STATUS != 'DELETED'
ORDER BY i.SORT_ORDER ASC, i.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ITEM SET PREVIOUS_STATUS = STATUS, STATUS = 'DELETED', DELETED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, DELETED_BY = #{deletedBy}, UPDATED_BY = #{deletedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE PARENT_ITEM_ID = #{parentItemId}

UPDATE TB_ITEM SET PREVIOUS_STATUS = STATUS, STATUS = 'COMPLETED', COMPLETED_BY = #{completedBy}, UPDATED_BY = #{completedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE PARENT_ITEM_ID = #{parentItemId} AND STATUS NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELETED')
